personal_context.title: Ongoing corruption trial (Cases 1000, 2000, and 4000)
personal_context.description: Indicted on 21 November 2019 by Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit, the first sitting Israeli Prime Minister ever criminally charged in office. Case 1000 alleges fraud and breach of trust over gifts accepted from wealthy businessmen. Case 2000 alleges fraud and breach of trust over a discussed arrangement with Yedioth Ahronoth publisher Arnon Mozes for more favorable coverage. Case 4000, the most serious, alleges bribery, fraud, and breach of trust over claims Netanyahu advanced regulatory benefits for the Bezeq telecom company in exchange for favorable coverage on the Bezeq-owned Walla news site. Trial proceedings began in 2020 and are still ongoing as of this entry: Netanyahu's own testimony concluded in June 2026 after 98 hearings across roughly 18 months, and as of July 2026 the presiding judges have twice suggested the prosecution consider dropping the Case 4000 bribery charge while retaining the lesser breach-of-trust counts — no charge has been dropped and no verdict has been reached. All allegations above remain exactly that: charged, not proven, pending a verdict.
